# Demo image sources and licences

**Status: temporary placeholder illustrations, not photographs.**

The 12 files in this folder (`<type>-1.jpg`, `<type>-2.jpg` for domestic, ro, uv, commercial, compact, premium) are
**original illustrations generated by this project** with `npm run demo-images -w server`
(`server/scripts/generate-demo-images.js`). Each one is stamped "DEMO PLACEHOLDER IMAGE". They show generic
rounded-rectangle silhouettes with no logos, brands or technical claims.

| Licence | Details |
| --- | --- |
| Copyright | Created for this project; no third-party rights. Free to use, edit or delete. |
| Attribution | Not required. |
| Hotlinking | None. All files are stored locally in the repository and uploaded into MongoDB GridFS by the seed script. |

## Why not stock photographs?

Real, royalty-free product photographs were searched for on Unsplash and Pexels. The results were not suitable:

* Almost every Unsplash "water purifier" result is **brand-owned product photography** (a commercial purifier
  manufacturer's own pictures, with visible logos). Although hosted under the Unsplash licence, presenting another
  company's branded product as sample VR Water Solutions stock would be misleading, so they were deliberately not used.
* Pexels results were mostly bottles, glasses, sinks and **industrial treatment plants**, not purifiers.
* Unsplash also blocks scripted downloads with a bot challenge, which this project does not work around.

## Replacing the placeholders with real photographs

1. Take your own photographs of real stock (best option: you own the rights), or buy/obtain properly licensed ones.
2. Admin dashboard > Products > edit the product > Images: upload, set the primary image, delete the placeholder.
3. Or delete all demo data at once: `npm run seed:demo -- --remove`.

If you later add stock photos from Unsplash or Pexels, record here: photo URL, photographer, licence, and the date
downloaded.
